source: Each district's own website, read directly. Verified 2026-08-27.

park-slope-5th-avenue.name: Park Slope Fifth Avenue BID
park-slope-5th-avenue.scale: Over 500 independently owned businesses along roughly 30 blocks.
events: May: Fabulous Fifth Avenue Fair, a twenty block street fair
June: Brooklyn Pride fair and parade
July and August: Summer Strolls and the Pop Up Park
November and December: tree lighting, menorah lighting and Santa visits

transit.subway: 2, 3, 4, 5, Q and R to Barclays Center; R to Union St, 9th St or 15th St; F and G to 4th Av-9th St.
transit.bus: The B63 runs the length of the district.
transit.bike: Citi Bike docks along 5th Avenue from Bergen Street down to 14th Street.
